title: Run directory contract v1 (pm/task_queue.mdx §9.3, §9.4)
description: Files in data/git_ignore/runs/<job_id>/ shared by the controller and the job's detached task host: task.json, run.json, events.jsonl, heartbeat.json, cancel, fence_request/fence_ok/fence_lost, result.json, exit.json, handled. This schema covers run.json, the record a restarted controller re-adopts the job from. Implemented in code: ~/BGit/act3/ai_processing_server/code/internal/runs/runs.go — Record, Task, Line, Result
